name: DPM++ SDE
plain: A two-stage stochastic DPM++ method: noisy intermediate stage, model call, then a blended x0 for the full step with more noise. Noise comes from a Brownian tree seeded from the run seed, so each draw is a function of its σ interval. Costs two model calls per step.
math:
Symbols: x current latent; σ=sigmas[i]; σ'=sigmas[i+1]; D=denoised (x0 prediction after CFG); U=uncond_denoised; d=(x−D)/σ. 
λ=half-logSNR, h=λ'−λ, λ₁=λ+r·h, σ₁=σ(λ₁), r default ½, fac=1/(2r).
Stage 1: sd,su=get_ancestral_step(e^{−λ},e^{−λ₁},η); h₁=−log sd−λ; x₂=(α₁/α)e^{−h₁}x−α₁(e^{−h₁}−1)D; if η,s_noise>0 add α₁·n(σ,σ₁)·s_noise·su. D₂ at σ₁.
Stage 2: sd,su for e^{−λ}→e^{−λ'}; h₂=−log sd−λ; D̄=(1−fac)D+fac·D₂; x'=(α'/α)e^{−h₂}x−α'(e^{−h₂}−1)D̄; add α'·n(σ,σ')·s_noise·su.

props.flow_const: half-logSNR via sigma_to_half_log_snr: λ=−log σ normally, λ=log((1−σ)/σ) on CONST; α=σe^{λ} (1 normally, 1−σ on CONST). First σ≥1 on CONST replaced by percent_to_sigma(1e-4); s_noise×noise_scale.

providers.author: Comfy Org and contributors
providers.note: Same algorithm; the _gpu name differs only by building the BrownianTreeNoiseSampler with cpu=False, so the noise tensor values differ for one seed. Node options list gpu first, so the node and the plain dpmpp_sde name use different trees unless changed.

label: from code
surprise: Stage noise n(σ,σ₁) and n(σ,σ') come from the same Brownian tree over overlapping intervals, so they are correlated.
